*F-acc* (Accumulator, vector commitment) is part of *Commitments and Proofs* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

The paper introducing this functionality also proves its equivalence with the earlier game-based accumulator definitions.

*References:*

- Baldimtsi, Canetti, and Yakoubov. [*Universally composable accumulators*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2018/1241). In Topics in Cryptology – CT-RSA 2020, volume 12006 of LNCS, pages 638–666, 2020.
